mutations.reason: Factory donor ROM updates target Xiaomi17; this F6 custom composition has no validated factory OTA channel.
mutations.metadata_action: Prune only removed paths from final filesystem metadata; do not retain stale oat entries.

identity_policy: Keep honest target/donor source identities; do not spoof locked state, verification state or service eligibility to influence update acceptance.

remaining_checks: Verify factory updater APK and its oat absent in final product filesystem
Verify ConfigUpdater and MIUISystemAppUpdater retained byte-identically
Trace actual property-load precedence for donor mi_ext OTA partition property
Review Settings behavior when updater target is absent
Record unsupported official OTA prominently in candidate manifest and user-facing build notes
Before any phone change, verify recovery route, current custom AOSP details, backups and separately authorized device procedure

limits: Removing this frontend is not proof that every possible privileged installer or manual sideload is blocked.
Native update mechanisms remain intact for platform lifecycle and recovery; their security checks are not weakened.
No phone writes or runtime tests are authorized by this policy.
